text:
sara: short check — I'm proposing we use a 'scope escrow' approach for this launch: features that are borderline for MVP get escrowed with clear acceptance criteria and a rollback slot. saves us from late churn. thoughts?

jamal: like a gated queue? i.e., features merged behind flags + explicit unblock criteria? sounds good.

nina: +1. Helps sales messaging too: we can promise 'feature X reserved for v1 unless criteria met' on the pilot contract. Need the criteria written in each PR.

kevin: ops note: any escrowed feature must have an automated kill-switch and monitoring hooks. otherwise we add risk.

jamal: proposal for criteria template: 1) perf delta <= 10% p95, 2) error-rate < 0.5% during 10k requests, 3) no manual infra changes. If met during 48h canary, feature graduates.

sara: good. let's slot the contested items: tenant SSO (escrow), in-console evals (escrow), advanced telemetry (defer), embeddings cache (ship), model-pinning UI (ship).

nina: for tenant SSO, add "pilot-only" label in docs and a signup form. Sales wants that language.

kevin: i'll build the auto-disable playbook and add to the PR checklist. ops-bot: please create a runbook ticket.

ops-bot: Created ticket #INFR-5823: "auto-disable runbook for scope-escrow features". ETA 2d.

jamal: dev owners: i'll take SSO escrow, nina takes evals, kevin owns auto-disable. We'll each add the gradation criteria as part of the PR description.

sara: timeline: milestone freeze in 6 days (1767060000). Need engineering sign-off on escrow PRs in 48 hours. QA must own the graduation test plan.

nina: QA ack. we'll draft test plan templates for escrow features.

jamal: adding flags + metrics to PRs today.

kevin: ops will add the monitoring dashboards and automated policy.

sara: action items summary: (1) jamal + nina + kevin: PRs with escrow criteria + flags (48h), (2) ops-bot/infr: runbook ticket #INFR-5823 (2d), (3) QA: test templates for graduation (3d), (4) PM: update pilot contract language. We'll close after signoffs.

nina: ack.

jamal: ack.

kevin: ack.

sara: thanks all — this should let us keep the demo surface while protecting the milestone. :white_check_mark:
